$description: Button (platform/components/Button): its tokens added after the shared set. The caret (owner, 2026-10-14): the thin outline chevron (expand_more) at the button's icon size, in the muted content color on the unfilled buttons.

button-caret-color.$description: Button caret: the thin chevron's color on the unfilled buttons (secondary, tertiary, ghost, danger-secondary); filled and disabled buttons draw it in the label's color.

button-state-layer-color.$description: Button (D-0037, docs/adr/0004): the Fluent 2 state layer's colour on the neutral, subtle and outline variants: the text colour, see-through.

button-state-layer-hover-opacity.$description: Button: the state layer's amount on hover (8%).

button-state-layer-pressed-opacity.$description: Button: the state layer's amount while pressed (10%).

button-state-layer-focus-opacity.$description: Button: the state layer's amount on keyboard focus (10%).
